station_endpoint: read contemporaneous English station_information from official discovery
system_endpoint: read contemporaneous English system_information from same discovery
unique_snapshot: first HTTP-successful structurally valid complete stations response
retries: transport/HTTP failure or truncated/invalid JSON only; never dissatisfaction with count/geography/difficulty
denied_access: stop without bypass or changed proxy/account

static_station_rule.station_id: nonempty JSON string; preserve exact UTF-8 bytes and leading zeros
static_station_rule.capacity: finite JSON numeric integer value, excluding bool/string; 0<capacity<100; no rounding/imputation
static_station_rule.coordinates: finite JSON numeric WGS84 longitude[-180,180] latitude[-90,90], excluding bool/string
static_station_rule.virtual: exclude exactly is_virtual_station=true; no dynamic status or vehicle/user/trip records

exclusions: record every original zero-based stations-array row, reasons, ID and original row
duplicates: same ID: physical capacity/lat/lon/explicit virtual flag must agree, otherwise DATA_BLOCKED; merge identical and retain all rows
source_order: station_id UTF-8 byte lexicographic; zero-based unique source_row_index
projection_range: all qualified WGS84 rows must lie within EPSG:32618 area; otherwise DATA_BLOCKED, no geographic exclusion
coordinates: pyproj float64, record full output then Python round(x,3); inherited three-decimal serialization

pure_rules.anchors: R57 four anchors per V: first SHA256 ordering; others max min Euclidean; tie smaller source index
pure_rules.compact: anchor nearest V in distance then source-index order
pure_rules.regional: farthest-first V within nearest 2V; maximize min distance, then smaller anchor distance, then smaller source index
pure_rules.inventory: R109/R57 delta=max(V,floor(.12*sumD+.5)); shortage sumD-delta, balanced sumD, surplus min(sumC,sumD+delta); original perturbation, total adjustment and both-sign repair
pure_rules.weight: max(.1,(D/maxD)^2), Python round six decimals, maximum normalization, round six decimals
pure_rules.depot: arithmetic centroid of serialized service coordinates, three decimals, placeholders100000/50000/0
pure_rules.distance: only original production Parser reconstructs Euclidean/1.5; no supplied distance matrix
pure_rules.min_ratio: four-decimal compatibility only, no inventory floor
